gen-dafont-redux-gf-prompt: Redux spreads wide, geometric letters with a quiet shift in line weight. Prompt, a sans with oversized small letters and open apertures, stays easy to follow over a whole page of text, never tiring the eye.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-pt-sans-caption: Wide-set letters with big, visible entrances into every curve give Redux its look, and the lowercase body is enlarged too. PT Sans Caption follows with unclosed, inviting bowls and a soft modulation Redux has more of, which suits the heading at big, short sizes.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-puritan: Redux enters each curve with a big visible run-up, and its lowercase is enlarged, with wide spacing throughout. Puritan, a plain sans with rounded forms and oversized e and a counters, would read as friendly and unhurried across a long passage.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-questrial: Wide letter spacing and a big visible entrance into each curve mark Redux, whose stems and hairlines sit in a close ratio. Questrial offers open c, e and s shapes and a single-weight, stencil-cut feel, so give its tall letters a modest size.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-radio-canada: Redux brings wide, geometric letters whose curves thin out modestly where they turn, while Radio Canada, a sans with tall c, s and z, stays flat and contrast-free. Its clear curve openings are the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-radio-canada-big: Radio Canada Big fills the line with a tall x-height and a monoline skeleton, its terminals finishing well clear of the stem. Next to it, Redux feels softer and more widely spaced, its ink traces carrying a restrained thick-thin ratio.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-readex-pro: Contemporary and widely spaced, Redux enters each curve with a big, visible lead-in. Readex Pro, a sans-serif with broad terminal gaps and unvarying stems and arches, would keep a long passage moving at a steady, unfussy pace.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-roboto: Contemporary geometry drives Redux, with wide spacing and crossbars a bit finer than its main stems. But Roboto, a sans-serif with generous mouths on its round letters, is the one made for steady text.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-ruda: A big visible entrance into each curve is what sets Redux apart, with medium contrast in its strokes. And Ruda's sizable x-height and wire-like monoline skeleton make this pair's strongest quality its easy screen readability.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-saira: Redux stands out for its wide spacing and big curve entrances, with modest stroke modulation throughout. Saira, a sans-serif with see-through s shapes and rounds stretching high, does the quiet work while Redux handles the display.
